items.title_zh: MOABB：使数据集气泡图可复现（#1168）
items.title_en: [NeuroTechX/moabb] ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible (#1168)
bullets_zh: MOABB提交#1168将六边形受试者布局中的全局NumPy随机状态替换为显式random_state参数。
固定默认种子使重复调用气泡图生成相同图形，同时仍允许自定义种子。
该改动支持EEG/BCI数据集比较中可复现的基准可视化。
bullets_en: MOABB commit #1168 replaces the global NumPy random state in hexagonal subject layout with an explicit random_state parameter.
A fixed default seed makes repeated bubble plot calls produce identical figures while still allowing custom seeds.
The change supports reproducible benchmark visualization for EEG/BCI dataset comparisons.
items.brief: MOABB基准库更新，提升EEG数据集气泡图可复现性。
items.brief_en: MOABB benchmark update improves reproducibility of EEG dataset bubble plots.
items.raw_excerpt: ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible (#1168) ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible Replace the global NumPy random state used by the hexagonal subject layout with an explicit random_state parameter. items.title_zh: MOABB：在预取NEMAR前使用缓存数据（#1169）
items.title_en: [NeuroTechX/moabb] Use cached data before prefetching NEMAR (#1169)
bullets_zh: MOABB提交#1169使库在预取NEMAR数据集前先检查本地缓存。
它在移除缓存后仍保留NEMAR优先行为，避免不必要的网络获取。
该更新提升了使用已缓存EEG基准数据用户的效率。
bullets_en: MOABB commit #1169 makes the library check local cache before prefetching the NEMAR dataset.
It preserves NEMAR-first behavior after cache removal, avoiding unnecessary network fetches.
The update improves efficiency for users working with cached EEG benchmark data.
items.brief: MOABB更新优化NEMAR数据集缓存，减少重复预取。
items.brief_en: MOABB update uses cached data before prefetching NEMAR to reduce redundant downloads.
items.raw_excerpt: Use cached data before prefetching NEMAR (#1169) * Avoid NEMAR prefetch for cached data * Preserve NEMAR-first behavior after cache removal
